tasks.label: CALM: Check Current File
tasks.command: common_dir=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir); case "$common_dir" in /*) ;; *) common_dir=${workspaceFolder}/$common_dir ;; esac; repo_name=$(basename "$(dirname "$common_dir")"); mkdir -p .calm && stack-fitness-functions client validate --file ${relativeFile} --repo "$repo_name" --git-dir ${workspaceFolder} --format sarif > .calm/results.sarif

tasks.label: CALM: Watch (run on save)
tasks.command: common_dir=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir); case "$common_dir" in /*) ;; *) common_dir=${workspaceFolder}/$common_dir ;; esac; repo_name=$(basename "$(dirname "$common_dir")"); while true; do inotifywait -e close_write ${file} 2>/dev/null || fswatch -1 ${file} 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p .calm && stack-fitness-functions client validate --file ${relativeFile} --repo "$repo_name" --git-dir ${workspaceFolder} --format sarif > .calm/results.sarif; done
